container.echostorage.echo_bundle.catego: With a Category, the bundle picks up what the Category matches. With none, it picks up what it already holds.
container.echostorage.echo_bundle.vacuum: When on, items you pick up go into this bundle first if it wants them. Off until you turn it on.
container.echostorage.echo_chest.categor: Items outside the Category are marked, never moved. Shift-click this button to go back.
When on, items outside the Category are refused from shift-click, quick-stack, hoppers and pipes. Placing by hand always works.
container.echostorage.echo_chest.quick_s: Puts away everything in your inventory, not your hotbar, that is in this chest's Category or that it already holds. Bundles inside that hold an item are topped up first. Shift-click only fills slots and never fills a bundle.
container.echostorage.echo_interface.emp: No Echo Chests linked. Run sculk from here to a chest.
container.echostorage.echo_interface.unl: Can't open: this chest, or the sculk leading to it, is in an unloaded chunk.
container.echostorage.echo_interface.los: Can't open: the sculk no longer reaches this chest. It was broken, replaced, or cut off.
container.echostorage.echo_interface.dis: Take this chest off the list
container.echostorage.echo_interface.qui: Puts away everything in your inventory, not your hotbar, into the linked chests: first those that already hold it, then those whose Category it is in.
